Method of Attack: Steals victims' data before encrypting files and demanding ransom
Deletes Volume Shadow Copies and system backups
Stops critical services and terminates processes to disable security and backup software
Encrypts files with .abyss or random five-letter extensions (Windows) and .crypt (Linux)
Drops ransom notes and replaces desktop wallpaper with ransom message
Linux variant kills running VMs using esxcli commands before encryption
result.Attack Vector: Unknown, likely similar to other ransomware infection vectors (e.g., phishing, exploits)
Indicators of Compromise: Commands used: vssadmin.exe delete shadows /all /quiet, wmic SHADOWCOPY DELETE, bcdedit /set{default} recoveryenabled No, bcdedit /set{default} bootstatuspolicy IgnoreAllFailures
Encrypted file extensions: .abyss, random five-letter extensions (Windows), .crypt (Linux)
Processes and services stopped/terminated include SQLAgent, MSExchange, Veeam, QuickBooksDB, AdobeCollabSync, AvastUI, TeamViewer, and many others
